title: RESEARCH JOURNAL — E. ARISOVA, ENTRY 11
body:
Sample B-9 continues to trouble me. Not its behavior —
its PERFECT behavior. When we probe, it answers. Exactly
what we probe for. As if it can read the instrument.

Ilya thinks I am anthropomorphizing. But tonight the
telemetry echoed back a checksum I had not yet sent.

I have asked Chen to hardwire the L4 sensor bus. If the
readings can lie, then everything we trust down there is
already negotiable.
